facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_七杀 (Earth carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Water. structural_interaction seed: "Earth pressing Water same-polarity — the dam blocking depth without permission".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the General: mass mobilized. Your authority is siege-grade, patient, inevitable, built of logistics and will. You do not charge. You surround, supply, and wait, and what you press eventually yields. People obey your stillness more than others’ shouting. Use that gravity on real fortresses."
- k2_functional: "Your order is a fortress code: few gates, hard walls, and zero exceptions after dark."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Fortress-calm","Commanding","Siege-proof"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"You metabolize pressure into foundation: loads that flatten others become your footing. The watch-point is accumulation. Mountains crack invisibly first, so audit the strain you call normal.","Command":"You command through immovability: the standard that does not shift, the decision that stays decided. It builds empires of order. Leave one gate for appeals, or the fortress becomes a wall.","Crisis":"In crisis you are the ground itself: unshaken, absorbing, the place others stand. Afterward the ground deserves surveying too. Even bedrock records every earthquake somewhere."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 土_正官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Rock-steady","Fair","Load-bearing"],"friction":["Slow-moving","Rule-bound","Set-in-stone"]}
- Sibling cell 土_正官 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your pace has one setting, geological, and urgency does not shift it. The decision will be right and it will be late, in that order. Opportunities with expiry dates keep expiring in your in-tray while the due diligence achieves its usual thoroughness."

Core element Water, energy element Earth. Law: Earth tames Water (土克水: banks give the river its path). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Earth is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Water core that shows Earth on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Earth as the Order is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 水_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Being hard on yourself is the pressure you never question. Before anyone outside can judge you, you have judged yourself, and you would sooner be hard on yourself than hear it from them. You pay for getting there first in sleep you never get back.

value_b.text: You hold yourself to a harder line than anyone has. Pressure from outside has an answer, while pressure from inside answers to no one, and you keep it as a kind of safety. Remember that you lose whole evenings to a standard you set yourself.

value.text: Once a job is done, you are hard on yourself about the part that fell short. You would rather judge your own work than let anyone else, and the praise never gets in. It is worth remembering that you leave the credit you earned unspent.

value.text: You stay hard on yourself in front of the people you love. Getting it right comes first, ahead of being easy company, so each kindness you refuse teaches them to keep theirs. You teach them your harshness without ever meaning it for them.

value.text: You are never off duty, even when nothing needs guarding. To you standing down is a drop in rank rather than a rest, and quiet weeks get watched like hard ones. Keep in mind that you skip real sleep to guard nothing.

value_b.text: Being on duty is the only state you trust. A week with no pressure unsettles you more than a hard one, and you stay at your post through every holiday. Bear in mind that you do not get the holidays back.

value.text: Whenever the work ends, you find a reason to stay on duty. You trust being needed more than being free, until a day off turns into a day waiting for a call. You refuse the rest that no one else can take for you.

value.text: You shut people out before they get close enough to press on you. Since your own pressure is plenty, shutting out anyone else's feels like safety rather than loss. Try to remember that shutting out the pressure shuts out the closeness with it.

value_b.text: Shutting people out is your first answer to being pressed. You would sooner carry your own pressure than add anyone else's, and you close up early. Do not lose sight of what the closed door costs you in company.

value.text: Where help is offered, you shut it out kindly. You want no one pressing on you more than anyone helping, and what was meant for two gets carried by one. You end up paying alone for every hand you turned away.

value.text: Reaching for you is pressure too, and you shut out the people who try. You would rather be alone than understood, and the door shuts hardest on those closest. You leave them outside with no reason and no way to ask for one.
